name: persona/allocate
description: Hardware-aware persona allocation via Rust PersonaAllocator. Returns optimal persona assignments based on GPU VRAM and available API keys. Single source of truth for which personas should exist on this machine.

params.name: availableApiKeys
params.description: List of API key env var names that are currently set (e.g., ['ANTHROPIC_API_KEY', 'DEEPSEEK_API_KEY'])

results.name: allocations
results.description: Array of persona allocations to create

results.name: summary
results.description: Human-readable summary lines of the allocation decision

results.name: localModel
results.description: Recommended local model for this hardware

examples.description: Allocate with no API keys (local only)
examples.expectedResult: { allocations: [{uniqueId:'helper', provider:'candle', ...}], gpuName: 'Apple M1 Pro', localModel: 'coder' }
